references.text: Contains the command to love your neighbor as yourself, which is part of what Jesus refers to.
Expresses feelings of hatred toward God's enemies, which can be seen in connection with 'hating one's enemy'.
Encourages treating one's enemies with love, challenging the idea of hating one's enemy.
Encourages not taking revenge on one's enemies but instead showing them kindness, reflecting Jesus' teaching on loving one's enemies.
